facts.statement: Seven is a card game in the rummy style.
facts.sourceSentence: Seven is a rummy-style card game for 1 to 7 players that plays in about 7 minutes, and is recommended for ages 7 and up.

facts.statement: The game supports a minimum of 1 player.

facts.statement: Expected play time is roughly 7 minutes.

facts.statement: During setup, every player receives one "Ways to Score" card.
facts.sourceSentence: Give each player a "Ways to Score" card.

facts.statement: Setup involves spreading the cards face-down in a jumbled mess in the middle of the table and mixing them around.
facts.sourceSentence: Create a mess of face-down cards in the middle of the table and mixes them around.

facts.statement: After the mess is created, each player draws 3 cards from it to form their starting hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player should then draw 3 cards from the mess to form their hand.

numericValue.unit: cards drawn per player at setup

facts.statement: Rounds are played simultaneously by all players rather than in turn order.
facts.sourceSentence: p.1, Round (Simultaneous):

facts.statement: In each round, every player draws 2 cards into their hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player draws 2 cards into their hand.

facts.statement: In each round, every player discards 1 card from their hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player discards 1 card from their hand face-up off to the side of the table in their own discard pile.

facts.statement: Discarded cards are placed face-up, off to the side of the table, in a discard pile belonging to the discarding player.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player discards 1 card from their hand face-up off to the side of the table in their own discard pile.

facts.statement: A player can determine which round they are on by counting the cards in their own discard pile.
facts.sourceSentence: If you ever lose track of which round you are on, count your discards, you will have 7 discards when the game is over.

facts.statement: When the game is over, each player has 7 discards.
facts.sourceSentence: If you ever lose track of which round you are on, count your discards, you will have 7 discards when the game is over.

facts.statement: Discard piles are public information that any player may inspect.
facts.sourceSentence: Discards are considered public information.

facts.statement: At the end of a round, the game ends if every player has 10 cards; otherwise another round begins.
facts.sourceSentence: If everyone has 10 cards, end the game; otherwise begin the next round.

numericValue.unit: cards in hand triggering game end

facts.statement: The game ends once all players hold 10 cards.
facts.sourceSentence: After all players have 10 cards, the game ends.

numericValue.unit: cards in hand at game end

facts.statement: At game end, each player scores their best hand of 7 cards.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player scores their best hand of 7 cards, and adds any bonus point cards (even beyond the hand of 7) to their score.

facts.statement: Bonus point cards add to a player's score even when they are not part of the scored 7-card hand.
facts.sourceSentence: Each player scores their best hand of 7 cards, and adds any bonus point cards (even beyond the hand of 7) to their score.

facts.statement: A match is made up of 7 games.
facts.sourceSentence: A match consists of 7 games.

facts.statement: Players play 7 games and record each player's running score total across them.
facts.sourceSentence: Play 7 games and keep track of each player's score total.

facts.statement: The player with the highest cumulative score when the match ends wins the match.
facts.sourceSentence: Whichever player has the highest total score at the end of the match wins!

facts.statement: The default and natural match format for Seven is a best-of-7 series.
facts.sourceSentence: A full match of Seven is naturally played in a best of 7 series.

facts.statement: Players who want a shorter match may play a best of 3 games instead.
facts.sourceSentence: That said, if you would like a shorter or longer match, feel free to play a match as a best of 3 games or a best of 10 games.
